title: Population-Based Post-Training for Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.29014v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is one of the most popular post-training paradigms for large language models. RLVR typically trains a single model under hyperparameters chosen before training begins, while researchers tune hyperparameters across consecutive runs. We introduce Population-Based Post-Training (PBPT), which trains several models in parallel and lets the training process do the tuning through population-based training. PBPT periodically evaluates models on a validation set. High-performers are duplicated and their hyperparameters perturbed to explore new configurations. Low-performers stop training and are replaced by these copies. On reasoning benchmarks (Enigmata, Nemotron) and interactive tool-use environments (Gaia2, AppWorld), PBPT produces stronger agents than compute-matched groups of independent RLVR learners. translated_title: 面向大语言模型的基于种群的后训练方法
translated_abstract: 可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）是大语言模型最流行的后训练范式之一。RLVR通常在训练开始前就选定的超参数下训练单个模型，而研究人员则需要通过连续多次运行来调整超参数。我们提出了基于种群的后训练方法（PBPT），该方法并行训练多个模型，并通过基于种群的训练方式让训练过程自动完成超参数调整。PBPT定期在验证集上评估各个模型，表现优异的模型会被复制并对其超参数施加扰动以探索新的配置；表现不佳的模型则停止训练并被这些副本取代。在推理基准（Enigmata、Nemotron）和交互式工具使用环境（Gaia2、AppWorld）上，PBPT产生的智能体比计算量相当的独立RLVR学习者群体表现更强。此外，PBPT能够从较差的初始超参数中恢复，自动……
tldr: 提出基于种群的后训练方法PBPT，通过并行训练多个模型并利用种群机制自动调整超参数，在推理和工具使用基准上以相同计算量超越了独立RLVR训练的效果。
en_tdlr: PBPT trains multiple models in parallel with population-based hyperparameter tuning, automatically adapting during training and producing stronger agents than compute-matched independent RLVR learners on reasoning and tool-use benchmarks.
